one_liner: Netlify's REST API manages deploys, sites, and DNS using OAuth2 or personal access tokens.
gating_notes: Self-serve free tier available; personal access tokens can be generated in the dashboard without paid plans.
oauth_details: Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication. Personal access tokens are used as Bearer tokens in the Authorization header.

auth_methods.quote: Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication... To authenticate API requests, include the token in the authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN>`

api_type.quote: Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps

api_breadth.quote: Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps, manage form submissions, inject JavaScript snippets, manage DNSDNSThe system that translates a domain name like yoursite.com into the address computers use to find your site.×, and so much more.

existing_mcp.quote: You can browse the [OpenAPI reference for the Netlify API](https://open-api.netlify.com/) to explore available endpoints.
